# Tatvam Overseas Inc

> ISO 9001:2015 certified stockist, dealer, and global exporter of stainless steel sheets, plates, coils, circles, patta (flats), pipes, tubes, and high nickel alloys based in Mumbai, India. Established in 1992 (originally Nagmani Metal), serving clients across 15+ countries with full EN 10204 3.1 Mill Test Certification (MTC) and 100% heat-number traceability.

## Core Capabilities & Inventory
- **Stainless Steel Sheets & Plates**: SS 304, SS 304L, SS 316, SS 316L, SS 202 (Jindal J1 / J4), Decorative & PVD Coated Sheets (Gold, Rose Gold, Black, Champagne in Mirror 8K, Hairline, Vibration finishes). Thickness: 0.5mm to 50mm.
- **Stainless Steel Circles & Discs**: Blanked circles in SS 202, 304, 316L for utensils, spinning, fabrication, and pressure vessels.
- **Stainless Steel Patta / Patti (Flats & Strips)**: Slit and sheared flat bars and strips for engineering, architectural, and fabrication works.
- **Pipes & Tubes**: Seamless and welded pipes in ASTM A312 SS 304/316L, Carbon Steel ASTM A106 Gr. B / API 5L, and Alloy Steel ASTM A335 P11 / P22 (IBR certified).
- **Nickel & High Alloys**: Inconel 625, Inconel 600, Duplex 2205 (UNS S32205), Super Duplex 2507, Monel 400, Hastelloy C-276.
- **Quality & Certification**: 100% material supplied with EN 10204 Type 3.1 inspection certificates. Mill test certificates supplied with every lot <!-- TODO(owner): confirm PMI / TPI offering -->.
